name: wechat-onchain-agent-runtime
description: Local Agent Runtime Host for the WeChat x on-chain agent console.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:runtime-integrity
scripts.test:unit: node --test lib/node-version-gate.test.mjs test/pi-compatibility-gate.test.mjs core/subagents/agwab-backends.test.mjs && node lib/runtime-paths.test.mjs && node kernels/pi/pi-kernel-adapter.test.mjs && node test/business-skill-smoke.mjs && node core/proposals/pi-builder-proposal-generator.test.mjs && node core/run-loop/agent-runtime-core.test.mjs && node core/gates/gate-engine.test.mjs && node core/final-output/deterministic-final-copy.test.mjs && node core/capability/capability-loop-read-model.test.mjs && node core/providers/runtime-tool-executor.test.mjs && node control-plane/model-route.test.mjs && node control-plane/smoke-test.mjs
scripts.smoke: RUNTIME_ROOT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/looloomi-agent-smoke.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_ROOT"' EXIT; export WECHAT_AGENT_TEST_MODE=1 WECHAT_AGENT_RUNTIME_ROOT="$RUNTIME_ROOT" MONGODB_DB=looloomi_agent_smoke_test; node bin/wechat-agent-daemon.mjs --smoke-check
scripts.async-smoke: RUNTIME_ROOT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/looloomi-agent-async-smoke.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_ROOT"' EXIT; export WECHAT_AGENT_TEST_MODE=1 WECHAT_AGENT_RUNTIME_ROOT="$RUNTIME_ROOT" MONGODB_DB=looloomi_agent_async_smoke_test; node bin/wechat-agent-daemon.mjs --async-smoke-check
scripts.smoke:security: RUNTIME_ROOT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/looloomi-agent-security-smoke.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_ROOT"' EXIT; export WECHAT_AGENT_TEST_MODE=1 WECHAT_AGENT_RUNTIME_ROOT="$RUNTIME_ROOT" MONGODB_DB=looloomi_agent_security_smoke_test; node bin/wechat-agent-daemon.mjs --security-smoke-check
scripts.smoke:business: RUNTIME_ROOT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/looloomi-agent-business-smoke.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_ROOT"' EXIT; export WECHAT_AGENT_TEST_MODE=1 WECHAT_AGENT_RUNTIME_ROOT="$RUNTIME_ROOT" MONGODB_DB=looloomi_agent_business_smoke_test; node bin/wechat-agent-daemon.mjs --business-qa-check
scripts.smoke:mongo: RUNTIME_ROOT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/looloomi-agent-mongo-smoke.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$RUNTIME_ROOT"' EXIT; export WECHAT_AGENT_TEST_MODE=1 WECHAT_AGENT_RUNTIME_ROOT="$RUNTIME_ROOT" MONGODB_DB=looloomi_agent_mongo_smoke_test; node bin/wechat-agent-daemon.mjs --mongo-smoke-check && node bin/wechat-agent-daemon.mjs --mongo-test-cleanup
